defs.def: a sweet substance, often in the form of white or brown crystals, made from the juices of various plants, used in cooking or to make tea, coffee, etc. sweeter 食糖

ex.s: Initially the sugar tax was expected to make £520m a year for the Treasury.
ex.t: 起初糖税预计每年为国库提供5200万英镑.

defs.def: the amount of sugar that a small spoon can hold or that is contained in a small cube, added to tea, coffee, etc. 一匙糖；一块方糖

ex.s: the shortage of sugar and our nutritional needs
ex.t: 糖的短缺和我们的营养需求

ex.s: Drinks now contain 45 million fewer kilos of sugar as a result of manufacturers' efforts to avoid the charge, according to Treasury figures.
ex.t: 根据财政部的数字,由于制造商努力避免收费,现在饮料中含糖量减少了4500万公斤.

ex.s: Since April drinks companies have been forced to pay between 18p and 24p for every litre of sugary drink they produce or import, depending on the sugar content.
ex.t: 自4月以来，饮料公司被迫为其生产或进口的每升含糖饮料支付18便士至24便士的费用，具体取决于含糖量。

ex.s: However, some high sugar brands, like Classic Coca Cola, have accepted the sugar tax and are refusing to change for fear of upsetting consumers.
ex.t: 然而,一些高糖品牌,如Classic Coca Cola,已经接受了糖税,并因害怕令消费者心烦而拒绝改变.

ex.s: Why was the sugar tax introduced?
ex.t: 为什么开始征收糖税?

ex.s: How did some drinks companies respond to the sugar tax?
ex.t: 一些饮料公司是如何回应糖税的?

ex.s: From which of the following is the sugar tax collected?
ex.t: 征收糖税的有以下哪些?

ex.s: What can be inferred about the adoption of the sugar tax policy?
ex.t: 采用糖税政策可以推断什么?

ex.s: Tracking of 150 biochemicals in food has been important in revealing the relationships between calories, sugar, fat and the occurrence of common diseases.
ex.t: 跟踪食品中的150种生化物质对于揭示卡路里、糖、脂肪与常见疾病的发生之间的关系十分重要。

ex.s: Many people enjoy relaxing music in the evening prior to going to bed．____37____While the validity of the idea is still being assessed，the lowered stress can even be tied back to blood pressure．Similarly, according to researchers，listening to just 30 minutes of soft music every day may help with healthy blood sugar levels， through the lowering of stress and anxiety．
ex.t: 许多人喜欢在睡前晚上放松音乐。____ 37 ____虽然这个想法的有效性仍在评估中，但降低的压力甚至可以与血压联系起来。同样，根据研究人员的说法，每天只听30分钟的轻柔音乐可能有助于通过降低压力和焦虑来降低健康的血糖水平。

ex.s: Most obviously, the men displayed lower blood sugar levels at the start of their workouts when they had skipped breakfast than when they had eaten.
ex.t: 最明显的是,这些男子在开始锻炼时表现出的血糖含量比吃早餐时低。

ex.s: Too much sugar is bad for you.
ex.t: 糖太多对你不好

ex.s: So, if you're a sugar addict and aren't able to say no to chocolate or cola, you had better download it now!
ex.t: 所以,如果你是一个糖瘾 并且不能说不巧克力或可乐, 你最好现在下载它!

ex.s: She uses a magic diamond to bring animals (their dog and cat), objects (sugar and bread) and elements (light, fire, water) in their home to life.
ex.t: 她用魔钻石将动物(他们的狗和猫),物品(糖和面包)和元素(光,火,水)带到家中生活.

ex.s: The Government's sugar tax on soft drinks has brought in half as much money as Ministers first predicted it would generate, the first official data on the policy has shown.
ex.t: 政府对软饮料征收的糖税带来了一半的资金,这是部长们最初预测的,这是关于这项政策的第一个官方数据。

ex.s: They reduced their products’ sugar content.
ex.t: 他们减少了产品中的糖含量。

ex.s: The sugar in soft drinks forms acid and attacks our teeth for about 20 minutes each time we drink them.
ex.t: 软饮料中的糖会形成酸性,每次饮用时会攻击我们的牙齿约20分钟.

defs.def: any of various sweet substances that are found naturally in plants, fruit, etc. （植物、水果等所含的）糖

ex.s: It is believed that today's children and teenagers are consuming three times the recommended level of sugar, putting them at a higher risk of the disease.
ex.t: 据信,今天的儿童和青少年正在消费3倍于建议水平的糖,使他们面临更大的疾病风险。

ex.s: He even moderates the amount of sugar that guests have in their tea, going so far as to cut up the cubes into smaller pieces in his spare time.
ex.t: 他甚至温和了宾客茶中含的糖量,以至于在业余时间将立方体切成小块.
